translation: Administer Bujin Wan (Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 補筋丸) internally, moxa-iron with Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散), and fumigate with Baxian Xiaoyao Tang (Eight Immortals Free-Wandering Decoction, 八仙逍遙湯), and it will be cured. <ins>Bujin Wan</ins> (Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 補筋丸) (seen in the injury of the yugu bone) <ins>Dingtong San</ins> (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散) (seen in the injury of the shanjiao bone) <ins>Baxian Xiaoyao Tang</ins> (Eight Immortals Free-Wandering Decoction, 八仙逍遙湯) (seen in the injury of the yuliang bone).
